name: air
description: air outside the body and in sinuses; BrainWeb background

name: cortical bone: collagen-bound water
description: water compartment, not a tissue: bound water (UTE T2* ~0.3-0.5 ms); pd rows add with pore water

name: cortical bone: collagen protons
description: semi-solid compartment, not a tissue: collagen backbone protons (T2 ~60 us)

name: cortical bone: pore water
description: water compartment, not a tissue: Haversian/lacuno-canalicular pore water (T2 ~ms-tens of ms)

name: skull (cranial bone)
description: calvarium/cranial bone (inner+outer tables and diploe unless region says otherwise)

name: yellow (fatty) bone marrow
description: BrainWeb marrow (skull diploe): adult calvarial marrow is mostly fatty (Loevner et al. 2002, AJNR 23:248, PMC7975248: in young adults haematopoietic marrow has usually converted; 84 % of 44 healthy adults iso- or hyperintense to white matter on T1)

name: brain
description: whole brain or unspecified brain tissue

name: grey matter
description: cortical (or whole) grey matter; deep nuclei are children of brain.gm.deep

name: deep grey matter
description: basal ganglia and thalamus taken together

name: cerebral white matter
description: white matter (regions in the region column)

name: chorioretina
description: retina + choroid (not separable at clinical resolution)

name: extraocular muscle
description: rectus and oblique muscles of the orbit

name: brown adipose tissue
description: brown (or supraclavicular presumed-brown) adipose tissue: multilocular adipocytes, higher water fraction than white fat

name: oral cavity (soft tissue)
description: oral cavity soft tissue incl. tongue and floor of mouth (radiotherapy OAR definition)

name: endometrium
description: mucosal lining of the uterine cavity

name: myometrium
description: smooth-muscle wall of the uterine body
